title: Do distances through five determine three-parent joins after the third three-output addition is itself a triple?
claim: Freeze and test sharp cutoff five for marked three-parent permission in the one-ternary serial family with exactly three three-output additions, the first two unary and the third with three parents. Let all other additions have two outputs, before or after the exceptional join. Compete against every reachable mixed presentation. Establish uniform bounds or identify a genuine miss and the precise residual case.
standard_statement: In the stated serial source family, every isometry of current bond distances clipped after five into an arbitrary mixed-law rival preserves the legal status of every marked unordered triple. Five is necessary.
prior_work: The all-size predecessor J settles two three-output sites after the seed. Its rank bound extends to three. A six-place ordinary site is new to this branch.
completion_gate: Score the two frozen predictions separately. Prove or refute uniform recovery, or report the certified range and an explicit remaining obstruction. Test sharpness using real reachable opposite triple permissions under a clipped isometry. When an opposing pair is found at five, test its full table.
source_contribution: Histories certify reachability and supply ground truth. The proposed reader sees the current clipped table, the marked unordered triple and the fixed law.

validation.status: V1. Same-task independent proof and reduction audits, whole fixed-point verification, eleven byte-identical replays under a fresh hash seed, and cut and flow measurements independent of the main recurrence. Separate referee review pending.

conclusion: When the third and last three-output addition has three parents, distances through five determine every current three-parent permission against every reachable mixed rival at every finite size. Five is sharp. When any triple is legal these readings fix every actual junction. The full table can hide a six-place equation and allowed states at width 28.
evidence_class: Mathematical theorem with an exact finite fixed-point step and explicit reachable sharpness and state-loss witnesses.
target_disposition: Both preregistered predictions held. The fully unrestricted inverse remains active on E.
unrestricted_obligation: The unrestricted mixed-output law remains open. At exactly three three-output additions in a single-ternary source, the third must have one or two parents for a triple counterexample to remain possible. More than three three-output additions also remain in scope for the unrestricted problem.
failure_conditions: A reachable opposing triple verdict under a full named bijection preserving the clipped table at five with a source in the declared class.
A missing legal frontier transition or a lost future six-bit cut under the augmented transition.
A rival violating short equation transfer, rank saturation or the two-shrink exclusion.
Failure of the explicit transposition through four or the width-28 full-table state witness.
